input.label: IDoc type
input.hint: Select an IDoc type from the target SAP system. If certain IDoc is not available in the dropdown, consider configuring it in the WE20 dialogue in the SAP system, before establishing a connection betwe…

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Set a batch size for processing multiple IDocs per job, aligned with the solution architecture and Workato webhook volume limits . For single-document processing, consider using the 'New IDoc' trigger…

triggers.name: new_updated_idoc
triggers.title: New IDoc
triggers.help: Triggers when new IDoc is received from SAP. This trigger listens to outbound IDoc in real-time. However since IDoc is asynchronous, your SAP system may schedule the IDoc to be sent at a later time, thus trigger may not receive it immediately. You need to configure the needed IDocs in your SAP syste…

input.name: idoc
input.label: IDoc name
input.hint: Select an IDoc from your SAP system. If a specific IDoc is not visible, please configure it in your SAP system and then click Refresh in the top right corner. Learn more

actions.name: call_bapi
actions.title: Call BAPI
actions.help: Use this action to discover and run a BAPI or RFM via Remote Function Call (RFC) in your SAP system. Please ensure you are using an OPA version >= 24.1 for the Business Object field to be populated, otherwise you need to manually enter the BAPI name in the BAPI name field.

input.name: action_name
input.label: BAPI description
input.hint: Describe what this BAPI does. e.g. Create Sales Order

input.name: business_process
input.label: Business Object
input.hint: Select the business object to which the BAPI belongs.

input.name: scope_type
input.label: Transaction ID
input.hint: Provide the transaction ID generated in the output of the Begin transaction action. If this is mapped, Force auto-commit will be disabled.

input.name: auto-commit
input.label: Force auto-commit
input.hint: If Yes , Workato will execute RFC call in stateful context and force BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT/BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK on completion. If No , whether BAPI/RFM will auto commit depends on its own setti…

input.name: protocol
input.label: Timeout
input.hint: Configure the timeout for this RFC to up to 30 minutes. If 30 minutes is selected, you cannot run this RFC in a transaction.

actions.name: idoc_status
actions.title: Check IDoc status
actions.description: Check if an IDoc is successfully processed in SAP
actions.help: Use this action to check if an IDoc is successfully processed in SAP. When you use action Send IDoc , Workato automatically attaches an unique Submission ID to the IDoc, so you can check the the IDoc status later. Provide this Submission ID in the input field below.

input.name: submission_id
input.label: Submission ID
input.hint: Use Submission ID data pill from the output of action Send IDoc . Or enter Submission ID directly.

actions.name: idoc_upload_new
actions.title: Send IDoc
actions.help: Use this action to send IDoc to SAP. You can configure the action to wait for SAP to process the IDoc before moving on to the next recipe step, or use another action Check IDoc status to check if the IDoc is successfully processed. Note that you need to configure the needed IDocs in your SAP system …

actions.name: trfc_begin
actions.title: Begin transaction
actions.help: This action signifies the creation of a transaction to run multiple RFCs in the same context. The output of this action is a transaction ID that can be passed to the Call remote function module action to execute it in this transaction. This action must also be paired with the End transaction action …

actions.title: End transaction
actions.description: End transaction and Rollback changes in SAP
actions.help: This action ends a transaction after multiple RFCs have been executed. Select Commit work to execute the BAPI BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT to commit the changes to SAP or Rollback changes to execute the BAPI BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK to rollback the changes. Learn more
